fieldValues.title: The method was designed before there were tools to practise it
fieldValues.statement: We designed a whole system of domains, personas, problems, tensions and gates, then tried to run it without working tools or a working process. For weeks the domains have fought me: I keep trying to align my own process with the agents', and the method costs more effort than the work it is meant to steer.
source_ref: Owner, 2026-10-24, reviewing the flow map (clerk#180): "We designed a system. But then never had working tools or process. The domains have been sitting fighting me for weeks as I've attempted to align my process with the agents."
